name: Social Content Agent
description: Reads your site and writes your tweets and LinkedIn posts every weekday.
scheduledTask: Read the website, pick one specific idea a customer would care about today, then draft 5 tweets and 2 LinkedIn posts about it.
examples: Write 5 tweets about what we shipped this week
Read my site and tell me what my positioning actually says
Write a LinkedIn post about the problem we solve

settings.label: Website URL
settings.help: The agent reads this to learn what you sell and how you talk.

settings.label: Who you are writing for
settings.placeholder: Solo SaaS founders doing under $10k MRR
settings.help: One sentence. The sharper this is, the less generic the drafts are.

settings.label: Publish automatically
settings.help: Start with drafts. Turn this on once you trust the voice.
